scope.rationale: D176.2 adds JSON-only recursive shape capture, scalar lowering/binding, slot grouping and presence metadata under src/nextorm.core/Query/Json plus the JSON-only preparer entry in QueryCommand.QueryPreparer/DataContext. The inner loop exercises the existing JSON-stream terminals and the JSON shape/plan builder. SQLite JsonStreamingTests is the end-to-end Phase-1 regression surface for the changed preparation entry; ClickHouse JsonRowWriterFactoryClickHouseDecimalTests covers JsonShapePlan.Build/JsonRowWriterFactory directly; core InMemoryTests covers the WriteJson in-memory guard. Flat Phase-1 behaviour must stay byte-identical, so these are the affected, non-broad classes.
scope.boundary: Full affected project sweep C02 (dotnet test tests/nextorm.core.tests -c Debug, no filter) after the last edit; the SQLite/ClickHouse inner classes are re-run after every coherent edit, and a final filtered SQLite JsonStreamingTests run confirms the end-to-end JSON terminal.
